name: Desert
overview: The Bible portrays the desert as a harsh, arid region characterized by sparse vegetation and desolation, often associated with wilderness and solitude (Deuteronomy 8:15; Jeremiah 17:6). Spiritually, the desert setting symbolizes both testing and separation, as seen when the scapegoat is sent into the wilderness bearing iniquities (Leviticus 16:22) and when God led His people through barren lands as a means of refining their faith (Jeremiah 2:2; 2:6). Yet, the desert is also a place of hope and renewal, where desolation can give way to blossoming and rejoicing by God's transforming power (Isaiah 35:1).
